answers.question: What is the dress code policy for Buff City Soap and Crunch?
answers.content:
Here's the dress code breakdown for both brands[p.16][p.17]:

**All Locations (applies to both brands)**[p.15]:
- Name tags worn and visible at all times; replacements are at the employee's expense[p.15]
- Tennis shoes or other full-coverage closed-toe shoes only — no sandals, crocs, flip-flops or other open-toe shoes; shoes must be tied, clean, and free of holes[p.15]
- Belts dark brown or black, nothing hanging from them[p.15]
- Hair of any length/color is fine as long as it's clean, groomed, and out of the face/eyes[p.15]
- Facial hair is fine if clean, well-groomed, and trimmed[p.15]
- Natural, reasonable make-up is acceptable and encouraged[p.15]
- Jewelry is fine if it doesn't interfere with work — no dangling earrings or chains, no pins/buttons on the shirt unless Management approves[p.16]
- Large, inappropriate or offensive tattoos must be covered; others are fine as long as they're not discriminatory or offensive[p.16]

**Buff City Soap specific**[p.16][p.17]:
- Shirts: any plain black, white, or gray t-shirt or long-sleeve shirt may be worn under the branded apron, or any branded top; not shorter than the beltline, not low-cut; clean and wrinkle-free, no visible patches, rips, or holes[p.16][p.17]
- Pants: full-length black or blue jean-colored pants are acceptable; yoga pants, joggers, or sweats are never allowed[p.17]

**Crunch Fitness specific**[p.16]:
- Shirts: two uniform shirts provided at hire (full-time gets 1–2 more); a plain black, white, or gray long-sleeve shirt may be worn underneath when cold; Group Fitness Instructors teaching non-proprietary classes (Zumba, Pound, etc.) may wear fitness-style apparel tied to the class; not shorter than the beltline, not low-cut; clean and wrinkle-free, no visible patches, rips, or holes[p.16]
- Pants: yoga pants, joggers, or sweats are approved for Instructors only (preferably solid black); Front Desk and Management must wear solid khaki or black pants; pants must be full-length, no holes or frayed edges[p.16]

One catch-all: "all aspects of the dress code are at The Company's discretion" — so if something's unclear, check with management before wearing it[p.17].

answers.question: What is the cell phone policy?
answers.content:
**Cell phone policy (applies across all brands — Buff City Soap, Crunch, Sun Tan City, JBA office):**

- Personal cell phones are allowed in the workplace but must be kept out of sight — not in back pockets, not charging in the break room, not sitting on top of a drawer till.
- Employees are responsible for protecting the guest experience; texting, calls, or social media use on the clock jeopardizes that.
- Phones should stay on silent and off your person while working.
- The only time a phone should be accessed while clocked in is in an emergency.
- Smart watches are allowed as long as they're not used for social media, texting, or calls — management can ask an employee to remove one if it starts interfering with the guest experience.

Worth noting: there's a separate rule for driving — cell phone use while operating a company or personal vehicle for company business is restricted, with texting/email expressly forbidden. Let me know if that's the angle you're asking about instead.
